answer: Practically, the chain should attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because lantern only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, wharf is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any forge approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
